risk_statement: A phishing email captures a finance user's credentials, the attacker takes over the mailbox and redirects a supplier payment (business email compromise)
existing_controls: MFA for all users; Defender for Office 365 safe links and attachments; phishing-resistant MFA for finance and admins (RTP-01)

risk_statement: Ransomware launched from a compromised laptop encrypts file shares and the WMS application servers, stopping dispatch at both warehouses
existing_controls: Defender for Endpoint with attack surface reduction rules; local admin rights removed; immutable backup vault (RTP-03, RTP-04)

risk_statement: Accounts of leavers stay enabled after their last working day because HR does not notify IT in time, allowing unauthorised access to email and the WMS
existing_controls: Leaver ticket raised by HR by email; quarterly access review of WMS roles

risk_statement: A Global Administrator or Azure Owner account is compromised or misused, giving full control of the tenant, subscriptions and backups
existing_controls: All admin roles eligible-only through PIM with approval; two monitored break-glass accounts; admin sign-ins alert to the SOC (RTP-06)

risk_statement: An injection or broken access control flaw in the customer portal lets an attacker read other customers' shipments and consignee personal data
existing_controls: Web application firewall in prevention mode; annual external penetration test; dependency updates each sprint

risk_statement: The payment webhook or provider API key is abused to forge payment confirmations or trigger fraudulent refunds
existing_controls: Card data handled only on the provider's hosted page; API keys in Key Vault with 90-day rotation; webhook signatures verified; liability clause in the provider contract (RTP-08)

risk_statement: Malware or an intruder on the corporate network reaches the conveyor PLCs over flat routing and stops sortation at the Dubai distribution centre
existing_controls: OT devices on a separate VLAN but routable from the corporate LAN; vendor support by on-site visit only

risk_statement: Unsupported Windows on the two HMI workstations is exploited because the conveyor vendor does not certify patches
existing_controls: Vendor maintenance contract; USB ports disabled on HMIs

risk_statement: A failure of the WMS virtual machines or of the Azure region during peak season keeps the WMS down longer than the 8-hour RTO
existing_controls: Daily VM and database backups; disaster recovery runbook written but not yet tested; capacity reviewed before peak

risk_statement: Consignee personal data is disclosed through misdirected email or anonymous SharePoint and Teams sharing links
existing_controls: Sensitivity labels and DLP policies for consignee data; anonymous links disabled; external sharing limited to approved domains (RTP-13)

risk_statement: Northwind cannot meet UAE PDPL obligations (data subject requests, records of processing, breach notification, transfers to ERP and telematics suppliers) and faces regulatory action and client loss
existing_controls: Records of processing, data subject request procedure, breach notification playbook and transfer assessments for overseas suppliers (RTP-14)

risk_statement: Customer service staff send shipment manifests containing personal data through a free overseas file-transfer website with no contract or transfer basis
existing_controls: Service blocked at the web proxy; manifests now exchanged through SharePoint in the UAE region (RTP-15)

risk_statement: The managed SOC provider's privileged access is compromised and used to disable monitoring or reach the tenant
existing_controls: Named provider accounts through PIM only; quarterly access attestation; right-to-audit clause (RTP-16)

risk_statement: An outage or breach at the fleet telematics supplier exposes driver location history or stops route tracking for a day
existing_controls: Contract with security and breach-notification clauses; telematics data limited to vehicle and route identifiers

risk_statement: A driver's phone is lost or stolen with the delivery app holding the day's consignee list
existing_controls: Intune enrolment with PIN, encryption and remote wipe; app data cleared at end of shift

risk_statement: Intruders enter the Abu Dhabi cross-dock out of hours and steal IT equipment or tamper with the comms room
existing_controls: Perimeter fence, guard at the gate, CCTV with 90-day retention, badge access to the comms room

risk_statement: The only engineer who understands the WMS integrations leaves or is unavailable during an incident, delaying recovery
existing_controls: Informal notes in the IT team site; supplier support contract for the WMS core

risk_statement: Unreviewed code or a leaked pipeline secret introduces a backdoor or vulnerable dependency into the customer portal
existing_controls: Branch protection on main for two of five repositories; manual release approval

risk_statement: An intrusion into the portal or WMS goes unnoticed for weeks because their logs are not collected centrally or kept long enough
existing_controls: Sentinel collects Entra ID, Microsoft 365 and Defender logs; portal logs kept 30 days in Application Insights only

risk_statement: A major incident is handled inconsistently, client and regulator notifications are late and evidence is lost
existing_controls: Incident management procedure; managed SOC triage 24x7; contact list for authorities

risk_statement: Warehouse staff share scanner logins and let visitors tailgate into the warehouse, so actions cannot be attributed and goods or devices go missing
existing_controls: Induction briefing; badge turnstile at the Dubai warehouse entrance

risk_statement: Staff paste customer data into unsanctioned cloud apps, including public generative AI tools, outside any contract
existing_controls: Acceptable use policy; Defender for Cloud Apps discovery in report-only mode

risk_statement: Backups are deleted or encrypted together with production, or cannot be restored, because backup administration and restore testing are weak
existing_controls: Immutable vault with soft delete; separate backup administrator identities (RTP-03); backup job alerts

risk_statement: New suppliers and carriers receive system access before any security due diligence, bringing weak practices into Northwind's environment
existing_controls: Standard contract template with a confidentiality clause; supplier register in the ERP

risk_statement: A power or cooling failure in the Dubai server room stops the local edge servers and the OT controllers they host
existing_controls: UPS with 30-minute autonomy; generator for the distribution centre; temperature alarm to Facilities
